caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bed frame with a lattice structure for supporting a mattress. The frame consists of four vertical corner posts and horizontal supports connecting them, forming a rectangular base. The headboard and footboard are both made from flat, solid wood panels with grain patterns visible, each panel having two symmetric, rounded notches cut out along the sides. The side rails have round pegs or dowels inserted at intervals and are joined to the posts. Across the middle of the bed frame is a grid of interlaced rope or cord, forming squares and providing support where a mattress would rest. The color palette is primarily light to medium brown, with variations to indicate the wood grain and shading. The background is plain and uncolored, and the artist’s name, "DWYER," is written in small capital letters near the bottom right.
title: Three-quarter Bed
